prompts.buildings: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game-ready pixel-art sprite atlas for Orange City RPG. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its rich detailed chunky pixel density, thick dark near-black pixel outlines, dark navy industrial cyberpunk architecture and warm orange emissive details. This is a new atlas, not an edit of the city scene. Render sharp nearest-neighbor-looking pixel edges, absolutely no antialiased vector icons. Create a 1536x1024 PNG with real transparent alpha. Exact 3-column by 2-row uniform grid, each cell 512x512. Six fully isolated building sprites, one per cell, never touch another cell; substantial transparent gutter on every edge. All roofs and stoops must fit wholly inside the individual cell. Each building uses front-facing elevated RPG 3/4 top-down perspective with horizontal front facade facing viewer/DOWN, architectural roofs with HVAC equipment and pipes. Door is warm orange lit and precisely at bottom center of its cell building. Top row: City Hall with orange compass sign and 'CITY HALL'; Maker Market with orange awning and cyan tech windows and 'MARKET'; Cafe Studio with orange coffee sign and subtle pink accents and 'CAFE'. Bottom row: Quality Clinic with cyan cross sign and 'CLINIC'; R&D Lab with orange flask sign and 'R&D'; Central Station with orange sign 'CENTRAL STATION'. Similar sprite sizes while distinct architecture. Entire atlas background genuinely transparent, not checkerboard art. NO ground plane, roads, people, characters, trees, UI, captions outside signs, decorative scene or shadows spilling beyond sprite. Exactly six buildings.
